ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A right-angle triangle is placed as shown in the figure, with point C located on the extension line of $FD$, $AB \parallel CF$, $\angle F = \angle ACB = 90^\circ$. What is the degree measure of $\angle DBC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given the problem, we can deduce: $\angle EDF = 45^\circ$, $\angle ABC = 30^\circ$,\\
since AB $\parallel$ CF,\\
thus $\angle ABD = \angle EDF = 45^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle DBC = 45^\circ - 30^\circ = \boxed{15^\circ}$.
